description: New Zealand Companies Register search (official NZ Companies Office): company name, company number, NZBN, status (Registered, Removed…), entity type, registered address and incorporation date for a name keyword, with the total match count and paging (15 per page). Data comes from the public register search page. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

query.description: Company name or keyword, e.g. fonterra

status.description: all (default) or registered (drops removed/closed companies from the returned page)

name: b2b_nz_companies_register
title: B2b Nz Companies Register
